65    /**
66     * Returns a random integer with 0 to $nbDigits digits.
67     *
68     * The maximum value returned is mt_getrandmax()
69     *
70     * @param int  $nbDigits Defaults to a random number between 1 and 9
71     * @param bool $strict   Whether the returned number should have exactly $nbDigits
72     *
73     * @example 79907610
74     *
75     * @return int
76     */
77    public static function randomNumber($nbDigits = null, $strict = false)
78    {
79        if (!is_bool($strict)) {
80            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('randomNumber() generates numbers of fixed width. To generate numbers between two boundaries, use numberBetween() instead.');
81        }
82
83        if (null === $nbDigits) {
84            $nbDigits = static::randomDigitNotNull();
85        }
86        $max = 10 ** $nbDigits - 1;
87
88        if ($max > mt_getrandmax()) {
89            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('randomNumber() can only generate numbers up to mt_getrandmax()');
90        }
91
92        if ($strict) {
93            return mt_rand(10 ** ($nbDigits - 1), $max);
94        }
95
96        return mt_rand(0, $max);
97    }

99    /**
100     * Return a random float number
101     *
102     * @param int       $nbMaxDecimals
103     * @param float|int $min
104     * @param float|int $max
105     *
106     * @example 48.8932
107     *
108     * @return float
109     */
110    public static function randomFloat($nbMaxDecimals = null, $min = 0, $max = null)
111    {
112        if (null === $nbMaxDecimals) {
113            $nbMaxDecimals = static::randomDigit();
114        }
115
116        if (null === $max) {
117            $max = static::randomNumber();
118
119            if ($min > $max) {
120                $max = $min;
121            }
122        }
123
124        if ($min > $max) {
125            $tmp = $min;
126            $min = $max;
127            $max = $tmp;
128        }
129
130        return round($min + mt_rand() / mt_getrandmax() * ($max - $min), $nbMaxDecimals);
131    }

143    public static function numberBetween($int1 = 0, $int2 = 2147483647)
144    {
145        $min = $int1 < $int2 ? $int1 : $int2;
146        $max = $int1 < $int2 ? $int2 : $int1;

179    /**
180     * Returns randomly ordered subsequence of $count elements from a provided array
181     *
182     * @todo update default $count to `null` (BC) for next major version
183     *
184     * @param array|class-string|\Traversable $array           Array to take elements from. Defaults to a-c
185     * @param int|null                        $count           Number of elements to take. If `null` then returns random number of elements
186     * @param bool                            $allowDuplicates Allow elements to be picked several times. Defaults to false
187     *
188     * @throws \InvalidArgumentException
189     * @throws \LengthException          When requesting more elements than provided
190     *
191     * @return array New array with $count elements from $array
192     */
193    public static function randomElements($array = ['a', 'b', 'c'], $count = 1, $allowDuplicates = false)
194    {
195        $elements = $array;
196
197        if (is_string($array) && function_exists('enum_exists') && enum_exists($array)) {
198            $elements = $array::cases();
199        }
200
201        if ($array instanceof \Traversable) {
202            $elements = \iterator_to_array($array, false);
203        }
204
205        if (!is_array($elements)) {
206            throw new \InvalidArgumentException(sprintf(
207                'Argument for parameter $array needs to be array, an instance of %s, or an instance of %s, got %s instead.',
208                \UnitEnum::class,
209                \Traversable::class,
210                is_object($array) ? get_class($array) : gettype($array),
211            ));
212        }
213
214        $numberOfElements = count($elements);
215
216        if (!$allowDuplicates && null !== $count && $numberOfElements < $count) {
217            throw new \LengthException(sprintf(
218                'Cannot get %d elements, only %d in array',
219                $count,
220                $numberOfElements,
221            ));
222        }
223
224        if (null === $count) {
225            $count = mt_rand(1, $numberOfElements);
226        }
227
228        $randomElements = [];
229
230        $keys = array_keys($elements);
231        $maxIndex = $numberOfElements - 1;
232        $elementHasBeenSelectedAlready = [];
233        $numberOfRandomElements = 0;
234
235        while ($numberOfRandomElements < $count) {
236            $index = mt_rand(0, $maxIndex);
237
238            if (!$allowDuplicates) {
239                if (isset($elementHasBeenSelectedAlready[$index])) {
240                    continue;
241                }
242
243                $elementHasBeenSelectedAlready[$index] = true;
244            }
245
246            $key = $keys[$index];
247
248            $randomElements[] = $elements[$key];
249
250            ++$numberOfRandomElements;
251        }
252
253        return $randomElements;
254    }

263    public static function randomElement($array = ['a', 'b', 'c'])
264    {
265        $elements = $array;
266
267        if (is_string($array) && function_exists('enum_exists') && enum_exists($array)) {
268            $elements = $array::cases();
269        }
270
271        if ($array instanceof \Traversable) {
272            $elements = iterator_to_array($array, false);
273        }
274
275        if ($elements === []) {
276            return null;
277        }
278
279        if (!is_array($elements)) {
280            throw new \InvalidArgumentException(sprintf(
281                'Argument for parameter $array needs to be array, an instance of %s, or an instance of %s, got %s instead.',
282                \UnitEnum::class,

284                is_object($array) ? get_class($array) : gettype($array),

338    /**
339     * Returns a shuffled version of the array.
340     *
341     * This function does not mutate the original array. It uses the
342     * Fisher–Yates algorithm, which is unbiased, together with a Mersenne
343     * twister random generator. This function is therefore more random than
344     * PHP's shuffle() function, and it is seedable.
345     *
346     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisher%E2%80%93Yates_shuffle
347     *
348     * @example $faker->shuffleArray([1, 2, 3]); // [2, 1, 3]
349     *
350     * @param array $array The set to shuffle
351     *
352     * @return array The shuffled set
353     */
354    public static function shuffleArray($array = [])
355    {
356        $shuffledArray = [];
357        $i = 0;
358        reset($array);
359
360        foreach ($array as $key => $value) {
361            if ($i == 0) {
362                $j = 0;
363            } else {
364                $j = mt_rand(0, $i);
365            }
366
367            if ($j == $i) {
368                $shuffledArray[] = $value;
369            } else {
370                $shuffledArray[] = $shuffledArray[$j];
371                $shuffledArray[$j] = $value;
372            }
373            ++$i;
374        }
375
376        return $shuffledArray;
377    }

379    /**
380     * Returns a shuffled version of the string.
381     *
382     * This function does not mutate the original string. It uses the
383     * Fisher–Yates algorithm, which is unbiased, together with a Mersenne
384     * twister random generator. This function is therefore more random than
385     * PHP's shuffle() function, and it is seedable. Additionally, it is
386     * UTF8 safe if the mb extension is available.
387     *
388     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisher%E2%80%93Yates_shuffle
389     *
390     * @example $faker->shuffleString('hello, world'); // 'rlo,h eold!lw'
391     *
392     * @param string $string   The set to shuffle
393     * @param string $encoding The string encoding (defaults to UTF-8)
394     *
395     * @return string The shuffled set
396     */
397    public static function shuffleString($string = '', $encoding = 'UTF-8')
398    {
399        if (function_exists('mb_strlen')) {
400            // UTF8-safe str_split()
401            $array = [];
402            $strlen = mb_strlen($string, $encoding);
403
404            for ($i = 0; $i < $strlen; ++$i) {
405                $array[] = mb_substr($string, $i, 1, $encoding);
406            }
407        } else {
408            $array = str_split($string, 1);
409        }
410
411        return implode('', static::shuffleArray($array));
412    }

414    private static function replaceWildcard($string, $wildcard, $callback)
415    {
416        if (($pos = strpos($string, $wildcard)) === false) {
417            return $string;
418        }
419
420        for ($i = $pos, $last = strrpos($string, $wildcard, $pos) + 1; $i < $last; ++$i) {
421            if ($string[$i] === $wildcard) {
422                $string[$i] = call_user_func($callback);
423            }
424        }
425
426        return $string;
427    }

429    /**
430     * Replaces all hash sign ('#') occurrences with a random number
431     * Replaces all percentage sign ('%') occurrences with a not null number
432     *
433     * @param string $string String that needs to bet parsed
434     *
435     * @return string
436     */
437    public static function numerify($string = '###')
438    {
439        // instead of using randomDigit() several times, which is slow,
440        // count the number of hashes and generate once a large number
441        $toReplace = [];
442
443        if (($pos = strpos($string, '#')) !== false) {
444            for ($i = $pos, $last = strrpos($string, '#', $pos) + 1; $i < $last; ++$i) {
445                if ($string[$i] === '#') {
446                    $toReplace[] = $i;
447                }
448            }
449        }
450
451        if ($nbReplacements = count($toReplace)) {
452            $maxAtOnce = strlen((string) mt_getrandmax()) - 1;
453            $numbers = '';
454            $i = 0;
455
456            while ($i < $nbReplacements) {
457                $size = min($nbReplacements - $i, $maxAtOnce);
458                $numbers .= str_pad(static::randomNumber($size), $size, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
459                $i += $size;
460            }
461
462            for ($i = 0; $i < $nbReplacements; ++$i) {
463                $string[$toReplace[$i]] = $numbers[$i];
464            }
465        }
466        $string = self::replaceWildcard($string, '%', [static::class, 'randomDigitNotNull']);
467
468        return $string;
469    }

514    /**
515     * Transforms a basic regular expression into a random string satisfying the expression.
516     *
517     * @example $faker->regexify('[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,4}'); // sm0@y8k96a.ej
518     *
519     * Regex delimiters '/.../' and begin/end markers '^...$' are ignored.
520     *
521     * Only supports a small subset of the regex syntax. For instance,
522     * unicode, negated classes, unbounded ranges, subpatterns, back references,
523     * assertions, recursive patterns, and comments are not supported. Escaping
524     * support is extremely fragile.
525     *
526     * This method is also VERY slow. Use it only when no other formatter
527     * can generate the fake data you want. For instance, prefer calling
528     * `$faker->email` rather than `regexify` with the previous regular
529     * expression.
530     *
531     * Also note than `bothify` can probably do most of what this method does,
532     * but much faster. For instance, for a dummy email generation, try
533     * `$faker->bothify('?????????@???.???')`.
534     *
535     * @see https://github.com/icomefromthenet/ReverseRegex for a more robust implementation
536     *
537     * @param string $regex A regular expression (delimiters are optional)
538     *
539     * @return string
540     */
541    public static function regexify($regex = '')
542    {
543        // ditch the anchors
544        $regex = preg_replace('/^\/?\^?/', '', $regex);
545        $regex = preg_replace('/\$?\/?$/', '', $regex);
546        // All {2} become {2,2}
547        $regex = preg_replace('/\{(\d+)\}/', '{\1,\1}', $regex);
548        // Single-letter quantifiers (?, *, +) become bracket quantifiers ({0,1}, {0,rand}, {1, rand})
549        $regex = preg_replace('/(?<!\\\)\?/', '{0,1}', $regex);
550        $regex = preg_replace('/(?<!\\\)\*/', '{0,' . static::randomDigitNotNull() . '}', $regex);
551        $regex = preg_replace('/(?<!\\\)\+/', '{1,' . static::randomDigitNotNull() . '}', $regex);
552        // [12]{1,2} becomes [12] or [12][12]
553        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/(\[[^\]]+\])\{(\d+),(\d+)\}/', static function ($matches) {
554            return str_repeat($matches[1], Base::randomElement(range($matches[2], $matches[3])));
555        }, $regex);
556        // (12|34){1,2} becomes (12|34) or (12|34)(12|34)
557        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/(\([^\)]+\))\{(\d+),(\d+)\}/', static function ($matches) {
558            return str_repeat($matches[1], Base::randomElement(range($matches[2], $matches[3])));
559        }, $regex);
560        // A{1,2} becomes A or AA or \d{3} becomes \d\d\d
561        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/(\\\?.)\{(\d+),(\d+)\}/', static function ($matches) {
562            return str_repeat($matches[1], Base::randomElement(range($matches[2], $matches[3])));
563        }, $regex);
564        // (this|that) becomes 'this' or 'that'
565        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/\((.*?)\)/', static function ($matches) {
566            return Base::randomElement(explode('|', str_replace(['(', ')'], '', $matches[1])));
567        }, $regex);
568        // All A-F inside of [] become ABCDEF
569        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/\[([^\]]+)\]/', static function ($matches) {
570            return '[' . preg_replace_callback('/(\w|\d)\-(\w|\d)/', static function ($range) {
571                return implode('', range($range[1], $range[2]));
572            }, $matches[1]) . ']';
573        }, $regex);
574        // All [ABC] become B (or A or C)
575        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/\[([^\]]+)\]/', static function ($matches) {
576            // remove backslashes (that are not followed by another backslash) because they are escape characters
577            $match = preg_replace('/\\\(?!\\\)/', '', $matches[1]);
578            $randomElement = Base::randomElement(str_split($match));
579
580            //[.] should not be a random character, but a literal .
581            return str_replace('.', '\.', $randomElement);
582        }, $regex);
583        // replace \d with number and \w with letter and . with ascii
584        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/\\\w/', [static::class, 'randomLetter'], $regex);
585        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/\\\d/', [static::class, 'randomDigit'], $regex);
586        //replace . with ascii except backslash
587        $regex = preg_replace_callback('/(?<!\\\)\./', static function () {
588            $chr = static::asciify('*');
589
590            if ($chr === '\\') {
591                $chr .= '\\';
592            }
593
594            return $chr;
595        }, $regex);
596        // remove remaining single backslashes
597        $regex = str_replace('\\\\', '[:escaped_backslash:]', $regex);
598        $regex = str_replace('\\', '', $regex);
599        $regex = str_replace('[:escaped_backslash:]', '\\', $regex);
600
601        // phew
602        return $regex;
603    }

631    /**
632     * Chainable method for making any formatter optional.
633     *
634     * @param float|int $weight Set the probability of receiving a null value.
635     *                          "0" will always return null, "1" will always return the generator.
636     *                          If $weight is an integer value, then the same system works
637     *                          between 0 (always get false) and 100 (always get true).
638     *
639     * @return mixed|null
640     */
641    public function optional($weight = 0.5, $default = null)
642    {
643        // old system based on 0.1 <= $weight <= 0.9
644        // TODO: remove in v2
645        if ($weight > 0 && $weight < 1 && mt_rand() / mt_getrandmax() <= $weight) {
646            return $this->generator;
647        }
648
649        // new system with percentage
650        if (is_int($weight) && mt_rand(1, 100) <= $weight) {
651            return $this->generator;
652        }
653
654        return new DefaultGenerator($default);
655    }

657    /**
658     * Chainable method for making any formatter unique.
659     *
660     * <code>
661     * // will never return twice the same value
662     * $faker->unique()->randomElement(array(1, 2, 3));
663     * </code>
664     *
665     * @param bool $reset      If set to true, resets the list of existing values
666     * @param int  $maxRetries Maximum number of retries to find a unique value,
667     *                         After which an OverflowException is thrown.
668     *
669     * @throws \OverflowException When no unique value can be found by iterating $maxRetries times
670     *
671     * @return UniqueGenerator A proxy class returning only non-existing values
672     */
673    public function unique($reset = false, $maxRetries = 10000)
674    {
675        if ($reset || !$this->unique) {
676            $this->unique = new UniqueGenerator($this->generator, $maxRetries);
677        }
678
679        return $this->unique;
680    }

703     *
704     * @return ValidGenerator A proxy class returning only valid values
705     */
706    public function valid($validator = null, $maxRetries = 10000)
707    {
